Sovereign digital commerce stacks are not a workaround for platform restrictions; they're the base-layer infrastructure that lets you deploy, manage, and scale your online store without relying on Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad. With a stack of interconnected tools, you can host your store on GitHub Pages, handle orders and payments with Cloudflare Workers, and deliver files via Cloudflare R2. This is not a 'Stripe alternative' – it's a declaration of infrastructure independence.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The core of a sovereign digital commerce stack lies in its components: GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. With Cloudflare Workers, you can automate delivery and order fulfillment, ensuring seamless customer experiences. As payments are processed, NOWPayments fires a webhook, notifying you of the transaction in real-time. This architecture decouples you from the constraints of traditional payment gateways.
